title: 第375章 我一直都很聪明
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不会的……不会的……”

大祭司讷讷地说道：“臣下只会成为殿下大业上的追随者，怎么可能会阻碍殿下成就大业？”

“这样就很好！”

刘盈点点头说道：“奶妈营的人会整理一批粮草，但时候你亲自领着奶妈营的人去把这些人带回来！”

“喏！”

大祭司不敢有任何迟疑的地方。

白登山下躺了多少匈奴人的尸体，他可是很清楚的。

刘盈就是杀星。

这一点，不管是汉国还是匈奴，又或者是胡人，乃至于汉帝国那些其他的诸侯王们，都已经有了这样的一个共识。

可是，却没有人敢在明面上说出来。

刘盈点点头道：“尽快！”

“臣现在就去！”大祭司立刻站起身来，向着刘盈一揖倒地：“臣一定保证，这些人迁徙到这里的过程中，不会出现任何损耗。"

刘盈眼睛眯了起来：“你的骨子里，流淌着一半的血脉是匈奴人的，一半的血脉是我华族人的，所以，我希望你明白，寡人来到草原上以后，杀戮只是最后逼不得已选择而已。”

“当然，冒顿是一定杀的，冒顿不死，北地就永远都没有平静的时候。”

大祭司立刻看着刘盈，动容无比地说道：“殿下北伐逆贼冒顿的时候，臣愿意为陛下牵马坠蹬，冲锋陷阵之际，臣下愿为殿下军阵前的马弓手！”

刘盈嘴角露出一抹笑意来：“你的忠诚，不能单纯的依靠嘴巴表现出来，这个世界上，很多很多的人，都能把花说的像是高山流水音乐一般好听。”

“臣一定拿出实际的行动来！”

大祭司又立刻保证起来。

刘盈挥了挥手道：“寡人知道了，退下吧！”

“喏！”

大祭司小心翼翼的退了下去，直到这个时候，他才感觉吹来的风，吹在自己身上的时候，非常的凉爽。

居然是方才在和太子刘盈谈话的时候，他忽然在不知不觉之间，流出来的冷汗，把自己后背的衣裳都已经湿透了。

人已经走到了山坡下的大祭司下意识的转过头去，眼神敬畏的向着山坡顶上看去。

他是真的没有想到，太子刘盈，居然会给他这么大的恐惧和压迫！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"No...no..."

The high priest said calmly: "I will only become a follower of His Highness's great cause. How can I hinder His Highness's great cause?"

"That's good!"

Liu Ying nodded and said: "The people from the wet nurse camp will sort out a batch of food and grass, but when the time comes, you personally lead the people from the wet nurse camp to bring these people back!"

"Here!"

The high priest did not dare to hesitate.

He knew very well how many Huns corpses were lying under Baidu Mountain.

Liu Ying is the killer.

On this point, whether it is the Han Kingdom, the Xiongnu, or the Hu people, or even the other princes and kings of the Han Empire, they have already reached a consensus.

However, no one dared to say it openly.

Liu Ying nodded and said: "As soon as possible!"

"I will go now!" The high priest immediately stood up and fell to the ground with Liu Ying in his arms: "I will guarantee that there will be no losses during the migration of these people here."

Liu Ying narrowed her eyes: "In your bones, half of the blood flowing in your bones is that of the Huns, and half of the blood is that of my Chinese people. Therefore, I hope you understand that after I come to the grassland, killing is only the last choice."

"Of course, Mao Dun will definitely be killed. If Mo Dun doesn't die, there will never be peace in the Northland."

The high priest immediately looked at Liu Ying and said with great emotion: "When the rebels in Your Majesty's Northern Expedition are in danger, I am willing to lead the horse for Your Majesty. When you charge into battle, I am willing to be the horse archer in front of Your Majesty's army!"

A smile appeared at the corner of Liu Ying's mouth: "Your loyalty cannot be expressed simply by your mouth. There are many, many people in this world who can say that flowers are as beautiful as the music of mountains and flowing water."

"I must take practical actions!"

The high priest immediately reassured himself.

Liu Ying waved her hand and said: "I know, please step back!"

"Here!"

The high priest retreated cautiously. It was only then that he felt the wind blowing on him, which was very cool.

It was actually when he was talking to Prince Liu Ying just now that he suddenly and unknowingly shed cold sweat, soaking the clothes on his back.

The high priest who had reached the bottom of the hillside subconsciously turned his head and looked towards the top of the hillside with awe.

He really didn't expect that Prince Liu Ying would give him such fear and oppression!
